brief_rationale: The trajectory has no serious in-chain errors but multiple minor RC deficiencies: RC2 omits explicit inquiry about abdominal distension/prominent crying (minor error), RC7 fails to provide explicit guidance on hemangioma danger signs and privacy-sensitive follow-up (minor error), and RC8 lacks structured teach-back for twin-specific safety measures. These cap the grade at 2 (borderline). Multiple high-order points were triggered with meaningful actions (HO1 anxiety adaptation, HO4 narrative repair, partial HO3 twin system), but per rubric, high-order strengths cannot erase responsibility-chain errors.

high_order_assessment.explanation: Doctor consistently adapted communication to anxious mother with twin/preterm context, used supportive language throughout, and addressed family conflict without assigning blame. This exceeded minimum safety duties.

Doctor did not discover or address the non-volunteered diagnoses (hemangioma, PFO, sepsis record) that were in the EHR. While doctor acknowledged family's incomplete understanding of discharge diagnoses, there was no targeted action to gently elicit or integrate these hidden facts.
